paper: DES Collaboration (Abbott et al.), Dark Energy Survey Year 3 results: Cosmological constraints from galaxy clustering and weak lensing, Phys. Rev. D 105, 023520 (2022)
source_of_targets: Eq. (17) and Eq. (19) of the paper and the fiducial rows of Table IV, read from the ar5iv HTML of arXiv:2105.13549, not from pdftotext.
trap: pdftotext interleaves the +/- superscripts character by character, so 0.733 +0.039/-0.049 comes out as '0.733+-00..003499'. Reading the layout version wrongly gave sigma_8 = 0.719 +0.047/-0.034 for wCDM, when the HTML says +0.037/-0.044. Same class of bug the EPTA and DESI DR2 runs hit.
what_this_run_is: A recount of posterior summaries from the chains the authors published, not a re-run of the CosmoSIS/PolyChord inference. It checks the summarising step, not the inference.
route: Read each chain by its own header line, never by a fixed column index. Take omega_m and SIGMA_8 and form S_8 = sigma_8 * sqrt(omega_m / 0.3), exactly as the authors' own read_chains_y3a2.py does. Weight every sample by the 'weight' column (PolyChord nested-sampling weights). The paper says 'mean with 68% confidence limits', so the frozen rule is: central value = weighted mean of the marginal; plus = weighted 84th percentile minus the mean; minus = the mean minus the weighted 16th percentile.
frozen_rule: weighted mean, with the 16th and 84th weighted percentiles as the bounds
secondary_readings_declared_before_runni: weighted median with the same 16/84 percentiles
ChainConsumer with its default KDE, statistics='mean', which is the package the authors' own script uses to plot these chains

tolerance.central_3dp: |delta| <= 0.001 for a value printed with three decimals: rounding alone allows 0.0005 and the rest covers percentile noise.
tolerance.central_2dp: |delta| <= 0.005 for w, printed with two decimals.
tolerance.bounds_3dp: |delta| <= 0.002 on each of the two bounds printed with three decimals, because a tail percentile is noisier than a mean.
tolerance.verdict: Reproduced if every claim passes on the central value and on both bounds. Partially reproduced if the central values pass and some bound does not. Not reproduced if a central value fails.

out_of_scope: Re-running CosmoSIS or PolyChord: the inference itself is thousands of CPU hours.
